correctness.rationale: The exact formula is proved by an independent exponential-clock reference process and a first-arrival hazard-ratio argument valid for every finite n and all positive rates. Strictly negative second derivatives prove unique interior allocation; KKT and controlled expansions establish ordering and both budgets limits. A separate subset Markov recursion passed 270 exact-rational comparisons, and 200 numerical optimization cases checked the KKT and risk ordering. No finite test is substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: For the natural goal of acquiring every required mutualist before local extinction under a total colonization-rate budget, the finding gives an exact n-partner success probability and complete unique allocation law. The arbitrary initial hazard cancels from the optimal split; budget shares move from uniform to square-root missing-hazard weights and yield a sharp survival-failure asymptotic. It offers a motivated benchmark for tripartite and higher partner assemblages, while all ecological assumptions and historical-priority risks are disclosed.
